resources.load_key_rule: assets[id].resource is extensionless Resources.Load key; file is repository-relative PNG path

property_documentation.schema_version: Integer contract version. Version 1 is measured static layout metadata, not gameplay rules.
property_documentation.screens: Keyed approved-screen layouts; source names the exact image. All center/size/rect values are full 1080x1920 source pixels.
property_documentation.screens.elements.rect: [left, top, width, height]; bounds include visible decorative art, not broad diffuse glow.
property_documentation.screens.branches: Observed source-side, perch-line endpoints and occupied bird center samples. Not level data or capacity rules.
property_documentation.assets: Keyed by final PNG stem; actual file dimensions, alpha bounds, resource key, and source metadata.
property_documentation.assets.alpha_bounds_xyxy: [left, top, right_exclusive, bottom_exclusive] of nonzero alpha in the final file.
property_documentation.assets.nine_slice_lbrt: Unity Sprite.border order [left,bottom,right,top] in original texture pixels. Keep asset-space borders when changing display dimensions.
property_documentation.assets.text_box: Safe code-rendered text area in actual sprite-local top-left pixels; scale with that sprite. Not a screen rectangle.
property_documentation.hud: Resource identities and observed three-/four-button screen element order. Concept positions remain in screens.
property_documentation.house_count_adaptation: Explicitly inferred centered layouts for unobserved K counts, separate from observed screen art. Do not promote to approved gameplay.
property_documentation.map.worlds.nodes: Ten measured placements per actual delivered background; index increases bottom to top. These indices do not assign gameplay level content.
property_documentation.map.worlds.nodes.measured_path_edges: [left,right_exclusive] of the tan path at the node y; center_x is the midpoint.
property_documentation.map.worlds.path_samples: Observed path samples in local map_world pixels; each has y, left, right and center_x.
property_documentation.map.stacking: Mandatory 160px baked-alpha overlap, 2840px stride, draw order, and topmost viewport requirement.
property_documentation.assemblies: Parent-owned composition contracts; pending status means do not infer sprite alignment/hinges from filenames. Assets may already exist while assembly contract is pending.
property_documentation.evidence: observed_manual_bounds = measured approved screen; delivered_file_inspected = actual PNG; inferred_* = disclosed layout/engineering proposal, not approved observation.
property_documentation.validation: Static file/geometry checks only. No Unity, input, animation or gameplay acceptance.

known_content_corrections: Minty gift uses gift_watering_can, not the gift box pictured in the approved popup.
Scarecrow uses icon_scarecrow over btn_purple, consistent with the purple-disc family.

notes: The approved K3 master depicts one house and four branches. This is observed artwork, not a three-house gameplay rule.
Visible bird counts are artwork evidence only; they do not define level data.
Replace the depicted gift box with Minty watering-can badge per T48. The badge rectangle is measured from the approved popup.

These six visible node positions belong to the approved 1080x1920 concept only, not the new 1080x3000 world backgrounds. Runtime world path node coordinates must be measured separately after generation.
Scarecrow card must use the purple round-disc icon family, correcting the concept.
K3 approved image shows only a single house. The seven-house beam is observed only on K7.
K1 through K6 use centered subsets of the observed K7 spacing; these are implementation layout proposals and require integration review.
K1 single-house master option is screens.level_k3.elements.house; it is larger than K7 beam houses.

stacking.order: Draw world N+1 above world N first; then alpha-composite lower world N at y=2840.
stacking.topmost_world: Clamp the topmost visible viewport to local y>=160, or back the first 160px with its preserved opaque raw source. Do not expose the top fade to an empty background.

map.method: At fixed sampling heights, detect the actual rendered tan path using source RGB thresholds, select its continuous interval nearest the previously measured path center, and take the interval midpoint. All 40 placements are visually reviewed on annotated composites. Sampling heights are layout choices; x coordinates and widths are image measurements, not a predefined curve.

contract.coordinate_system: Top-left pixels in parent canvas; shared house frame 512x512. Composite at zero offset, no trimming at import.

composition.closed: Place body, selected roof, then door leaf at zero offset on shared 512x512 canvas. Preserve transparent canvas at import.
composition.open_fallback: Replace body+door-leaf with house_door_open, then add selected roof at zero offset. Fallback already contains body and excludes roof.
composition.bird_face: Center bird face on door_center_xy and clip to the circular dark doorway; bird sprite scale is not defined by this asset contract.
composition.rope: Connect rope.bottom_anchor_xy to roof_suspension_anchor_xy after applying each part display scale.
composition.beam: Beam anchors are beam-local asset pixels, not approved-screen house positions; scale beam-local anchors with the beam.

contract.evidence: delivered_aligned_sprite_contract_static_QA_reviewed; door angle is a supplied engineering animation target, not runtime-verified motion

contract.open_fallback: Bamboo backdrop; projected/mirrored generated door leaves swing outward. Static fallback only; not proof of animated rotation.

open_fallback_transforms.note: Crops refer to prepared 556x626 doors_pair. Static projected view; runtime swing uses recorded outer hinges.

contract.nest_foreground_crop: for each x column retain y >= round(600 - 0.001*(x-384)^2); existing pixels only

checks: All asset PNG dimensions and alpha bounds read from files.

measurement_notes.method: Manual visual bounds on 540x960 inspection copies; all values multiplied by 2. Bounds include visible decorative silhouette, excluding broad diffuse glow unless named. Centers and sizes are observed art positions, not UI hit targets. Approximate edge uncertainty +/-8 source px; natural branches and glow +/-16 px.

Unapproved K3 alt1/alt2 are not layout authority.
